title: PixzFlow Task State
description: Compact persistent task state — the continuity substrate of PixzFlow 2.0. Replaces schemas/workflow.schema.json (11-phase model). Principle: state over phase. status tracks liveness; plan/findings/evidence/capabilities track content. One file per task (e.g. .pixz/task-state.json). Designed to survive context compaction, session restart, subagent handoff, model change, and runtime change. Keep entries short: summaries + references, never transcripts.

objective.description: Verifiable goal in one or two sentences. Restate on resume — drift counter.

status.description: Liveness only — not a phase list. 'verifying' is a liveness state, not a ceremony.

mode.description: Operating depth selected during ASSESS; see AGENTS.md#operating-modes.

assessment.description: Qualitative bands, not numeric scores. Reassess when material new information arrives.

plan.description: Minimal execution plan. fast mode: 0-2 steps or omitted. Each step independently verifiable.

iteration.description: Bumped on replan; cap via registry limits.max_iterations.

status.description: Never delete a decision — mark it. Drift counter.

findings.description: Claim ledger (the epistemic state engine). Label where uncertainty matters; do not label every trivial sentence.

evidence_refs.description: IDs into evidence[]. This is the claim→evidence edge.

falsification.description: What observation would break this claim.

evidence.description: Compact evidence ledger. The 'graph' is the set of references: findings.evidence_refs, evidence.verified_against. No graph database.

kind.description: kind drives source-of-record weighting: artifact/filesystem/git/test_result/command_output are primary for system state; agent_report/log/documentation are descriptive.

source.description: Where it lives / how it was produced (path, command, URL).

verified_against.description: If a descriptive record was checked against a primary artifact, name the artifact here. Empty = unverified record.

capabilities.description: Persistent skill/capability activation state. Survives phase transitions and compaction. state_digest is compact — never full skill text.

status.description: Lifecycle per AGENTS.md#capability-activation. Re-enter 'reactivation_required' when listed conditions fire.

state_digest.description: One-to-three lines: what this capability established.

failures.description: Failure ledger. Every retry must add information — this is where it is recorded.

lesson.description: What the next attempt must not repeat.

when.description: Trigger: before-irreversible / after-mutation / before-claim / before-handoff / before-completion / regression.

return_ref.description: Where the structured handoff return is stored.

next_action.description: The single recommended next step. Required on resume — makes continuation deterministic.

checkpoint.description: Last checkpoint. Written before long substeps, before irreversible actions, and at phase boundaries.

adaptation.description: Pointer to the runtime-level self-learning state (schemas/adaptation-state.schema.json, default .pixz/adaptation-state.json). PixzFlow 2.1: ORIENT checks this — if missing or stale, run the post-install activation lifecycle (pixz.core.self-learning) once; never re-run setup when status is ready and no drift.

status.description: Mirror of adaptation.status observed at last check.
